summary: The chord-width implementation, representative-plane selection, production defaults, and focused unit tests are reproducible, but acceptance is blocked because batch/raw output contracts still expose and summarize the legacy EDT measurement under unqualified width names. Thus the legacy measurement remains capable of being interpreted as primary in affected batch, GUI-batch, and command-line outputs. Integration coverage does not exercise these production serialization/report paths.

findings.title: Legacy EDT width still drives unqualified batch and raw-output fields
findings.impact: Users and downstream code can consume width_px, width_um, length_width_ratio, or batch mean_width_um as the apparent primary width even though those values remain the superseded EDT measurement. This violates the acceptance criterion that legacy EDT fields be explicitly labelled and not drive primary reports, and makes behavior dependent on which output surface is used.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3568-3574 stores the EDT median in width_px while adding body_width separately.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4787-4803 emits both unqualified EDT-derived fields and explicitly labelled legacy aliases.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8295-8312 derives batch mean_width_um from the EDT-backed width_px field.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8385-8433 supplies the resulting detection and slice-summary frames to CSV, PDF, and Excel report generation.
findings.recommendation: Preserve backward compatibility only through explicitly named *_dt_legacy fields. Make unqualified production width fields either the chord measurement or remove them from primary contracts, rename mean_width_um to an explicit legacy name, and add regression tests against emitted single-image CSV, batch summary CSV, Excel, PDF source data, GUI-batch, CLI, and study-manager outputs.

findings.title: Tests do not cover the affected production report surfaces
findings.impact: The focused suite passes while the contradictory batch serialization remains live, demonstrating false confidence at the integration boundary. Future changes can also regress GUI, CLI, study-manager, and report field selection without failing claim-specific tests.
evidence: Focused command `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q -s -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py tests/test_tuner_v571_body_width.py` passed all 14 tests.
tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:102-136 stops at rows_from_results and tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:220-246 tests only build_analysis_summary.
tests/test_tuner_v571_body_width.py:16-90 uses synthetic in-memory rows and does not invoke tuner CLI/profile serialization.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8422-8433 contains unexercised PDF and Excel production report calls.
findings.recommendation: Add focused integration tests using a tiny synthetic mask/detection fixture that run each entry-point contract without image inference and inspect emitted CSV, analysis summary, Excel cells, PDF source tables, tuner artifacts, and study-manager specimen summaries.

findings.title: Current audit working tree is not represented by its manifest
findings.impact: The acceptance run cannot be reconstructed solely from reviewed commit fc3aed7b because its active run directory is untracked, while its manifest states the tree was clean. Files added or changed within that directory can alter the audit record without changing the reviewed commit.
evidence: `git status --short` returned `?? audits/runs/20260828-v571-body-width-acceptance-rc2/`.
audits/runs/20260828-v571-body-width-acceptance-rc2/manifest.json:8-11 records dirty_worktree=false with no working-tree entries.
audits/runs/20260828-v571-body-width-acceptance-rc2/manifest.json:17 records completed_at_utc=null and lines 18-20 contain no role exit codes.
findings.recommendation: When the append-only run completes, retain a commit-bound or cryptographically sealed run manifest that accurately records generated untracked audit files and their hashes; do not describe the post-generation tree as clean.

limitations: A full image stack was not run, as instructed.

The first pytest attempt could not start because the restricted read-only environment provided no writable temporary directory. Re-running with `-s -p no:cacheprovider` avoided capture/cache writes and completed the 14 focused claim tests.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
GUI windows and binary PDF/Excel generation were inspected through source paths rather than executed because the workspace is read-only and production report generation writes files.
recommended_follow_up: Correct the unqualified legacy width fields and batch mean_width_um contract, then create a superseding audit run.
Add small write-isolated integration tests for all required entry points and report surfaces.
Re-run the focused body-width and tuner tests in the validated virtual environment and record exact commands and outputs in a commit-bound validation receipt.
Seal the completed append-only audit run with accurate working-tree and artifact hashes.
